purpose: Interpretation of legacy panel metadata without changing checksum-locked inputs or numeric values.

CRPS.definition: Weighted mean of squared cumulative-probability errors, divided by K-1 with K=3 ordered preference classes.

tail_MAE.definition: Mean absolute error of the predicted warmer and cooler preference shares.

legacy_helper.normalization: Summed cumulative-probability errors. For three classes this helper is exactly twice the normalized paper RPS.
